notes: «أَبِی ره» is the compiler's father, named only by relation; «ره» is a blessing and is left out
«شيخ من أصحابنا يكنى بأبي عبد الله» is identified only by his kunya, written as it stands (owner ruling 3); «عن رجل» is unnamed
The Imam after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); the Prophet is the end of the chain
